root_cause.text: The `build_i2c_fw_hdr` function in the `io_ti` USB serial driver fails to validate that the firmware image length (`img_header->Length`) does not exceed the remaining capacity of the allocated destination buffer before performing a `memcpy`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that `memcpy` is called with a size of `le16_to_cpu(img_header->Length)` into `buffer + sizeof(struct ti_i2c_firmware_rec)`. The fix adds a check to reject the image if `le16_to_cpu(img_header->Length) > buffer_size - sizeof(struct ti_i2c_firmware_rec)` to prevent a heap overflow.

It then copies data into this buffer using `memcpy` with a length of `le16_to_cpu(img_header->Length)` starting at offset `sizeof(struct ti_i2c_firmware_rec)` (lines 901-903).
